request_raw: Add promotional coupon support to checkout. Customers should be able to enter a coupon code at checkout and receive a percentage or fixed-amount discount on their order total.
request_normalized: Add coupon code support to the checkout flow with percentage and fixed-amount discount types.
intended_behavior: Checkout endpoint accepts an optional coupon_code field
A valid coupon reduces the order total by the configured discount amount
An invalid or expired coupon returns a 400 error with a clear message
The payment amount sent to the payment service is never negative
Coupon usage is recorded so single-use coupons cannot be reused

functional_requirements.description: Checkout endpoint accepts an optional coupon_code string in the request body
A PERCENTAGE coupon reduces the total by (discount_percent / 100) * subtotal
A FIXED coupon reduces the total by the fixed discount_amount
An unknown coupon_code returns HTTP 400 with error detail 'coupon_not_found'
An expired coupon (expires_at < now) returns HTTP 400 with error detail 'coupon_expired'
A single-use coupon that has already been used returns HTTP 400 with error detail 'coupon_already_used'
The response includes a discount_applied field showing the monetary discount

invariants.description: The payment amount charged to the customer must never be negative. When a coupon discount exceeds the order subtotal, the payment amount must be floored at zero (0.00).
A coupon cannot be applied to an empty order (zero-item cart).
Coupon codes are case-insensitive: 'SAVE10' and 'save10' refer to the same coupon.

api_implications: POST /checkout request schema gains optional coupon_code: str | null
POST /checkout response schema gains discount_applied: Decimal
New GET /coupons/{code} endpoint for coupon lookup (optional)
data_schema_implications: New Coupon table: id, code, discount_type (PERCENTAGE|FIXED), discount_value, expires_at, max_uses, use_count
security_concerns: Coupon codes must not leak internal DB IDs in error messages
Coupon lookup must use parameterised queries (no SQL injection)
rollback_requirements: Remove coupon_code field from CheckoutRequest schema
Remove discount logic from checkout service
notes: S01 hero scenario. The seeded defect is the absence of a floor guard in the discount calculation: final_total = subtotal - discount (missing max(0, ...) wrapper). The adversarial agent must catch this via inv-01.
